profile.name: Rui Jin
profile.headline: AI/ML Engineer
profile.bio: I build machine learning systems that run in real time on low-power hardware, along with the data pipelines, evaluation tools, and apps around them. I've spent 7+ years shipping ML and full-stack software, most of it remotely with US-based teams.
profile.summary: AI/ML engineer with 7+ years of experience building computer vision and machine learning systems, from real-time pose tracking on low-power edge devices to the data pipelines, MLOps tooling, and full-stack web apps around them. Hands-on with Python, TensorFlow, OpenCV, YOLO, React, Next.js, AWS, and Google Cloud, and currently doing LLM training and evaluation work.

about: Most of my work sits where machine learning meets real products. I'm at my best with real-time computer vision on small, low-power devices, where models have to be fast and reliable with no cloud to fall back on. I train and tune models in Python with TensorFlow and scikit-learn, and I'm just as comfortable building the React or Next.js app that puts a model in front of users, or the AWS and Google Cloud infrastructure it runs on.

At Nex, I worked on the body tracking behind Nex Playground, a game console you play by moving around. That meant training and optimizing lightweight vision models, writing the low-latency camera, sensor fusion, and inference code around them, and building the data pipelines and debugging tools we used to test and ship them.

Before Nex, I delivered 20+ full-stack and AI integration projects on Upwork and connected a company platform to its computer vision models. Today I do LLM training and evaluation work with Outlier and DataAnnotation, and in May 2026 I passed micro1's AI interview to become a certified AI/ML Engineer.
